Adds controller navigation to menus and restores the Android file-buffer cache used by Ultra cinematics.

## Changes

- Navigate menus with a visible pointer: D-pad or left stick to move, Cross to click/drag, and Circle to go back. Touch takes priority; the pointer is hidden during combat and system keyboard entry.
- Dismiss Android's unavailable quit confirmation when Circle is pressed on Main, preventing the menu from waiting indefinitely. Use the Vita system UI to exit.
- Restore the original shared-buffer file cache and its reset callback. A repeated Ryu Ultra test now makes 2 complete movie-file reads instead of 132 for the same 132 requests, without allocating another movie buffer. This removes verified redundant I/O; confirmation that it resolves the reported entry/exit pauses on physical Vita is still pending.
- Extend optional `debug_timing=1` diagnostics with scene/camera transitions, slow frames and readback timing.
- Document the complete asset requirements for the 32-character roster and validate them independently of savedata.

## Unlocking the roster

**You do not need an unlocked savedata, an unlock code, or a configuration switch.** The loader enables all 32 characters when the complete local pack from your own matching Android copy passes its file checks.

Copy the full `assets/` and `demand_assets/` directories, including the original `_filelist.txt`, downloaded character data and required `.obm`, `.bin` and `.idx` files. The base APK or selection portraits alone may be incomplete. If only four characters appear, check `ux0:data/sf4ce/boot.log` and the [README requirements](https://github.com/frangarcj/sf4ce_vita/blob/v1.0-rc3/README.md#unlocking-all-32-characters), restore missing files, and restart. Keep your existing save.

## Validation

- Host regression tests use ASan/UBSan; the Vita build and VPK contents are checked by GitHub Actions.
- Vita3K checks cover controller menu navigation, Options/Back, repeated cancellation on Main followed by training, Ryu Ultra cinematics, return to combat, and pause/continuation.
- Isolated roster checks: fresh save plus complete pack = 32 selectable characters; fresh save without pack activation = 4; existing save without pack activation = 4. Original saves and executable were restored with hashes unchanged.
- Physical Vita performance and the reported cinematic pauses still need confirmation. This remains a test candidate.

## Installation and upgrade

Install `SF4CE.vpk` using VitaShell. Existing game data stays in `ux0:data/sf4ce/`; deleting your save is not required. Prerequisites remain kubridge, FdFix (unless using rePatch), and `libshacccg.suprx`.

A legally obtained ARMv7 Android 1.05.00 copy and its matching libraries/data are required. **No APK, Android libraries, game assets, music or video are included.** Offline-service and Vita3K compatibility limitations from [v1.0-rc1](https://github.com/frangarcj/sf4ce_vita/releases/tag/v1.0-rc1) still apply. `SHA256SUMS` verifies the attached VPK; matching loader source is available in this release's tag/source archives.
